page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9a.32xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs utilizing AMD EPYC 9T25 processors operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. The instance is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring network-attached storage volumes for persistent data. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps to support high-throughput network operations. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated AMD EPYC hardware profile offers a dense allocation of compute and memory resources, making it suitable for enterprise workloads that require predictable performance without the overhead of local storage maintenance.

The ecs.g9a.32xlarge is designed for general-purpose workloads. Its balanced resource ratio makes it suitable for multi-threaded applications, enterprise web serving, container orchestration, distributed caching, and medium-sized database deployments that rely on network-attached storage.
